newsitem.title: UK: Ibstock appoints new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Ibstock appoints new chief executive.

text.p: British brick manufacturer Ibstock Plc said on Thursday it had appointed Philip Mengel as the company's chief executive with immediate effect to replace Ian Maclellan who would resign from the board at the end of the year.
Mengel, aged 52, has headed Ibstock's U.S. subsidiary, Glen-Gery since 1990 and has been a group director since 1993.
Ibstock's chairman Sir Colin Hope said in a statement that Mengel helped to bring the firm's U.S. business out of the red and enabled it to expand in the last 18 months.
